prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: art direction concept for a 2D astronomy detective game for high-school and university students and curious adults. Primary request: create one polished 16:9 landscape concept image of a warm hand-painted ground-based radio observatory office at night. The player investigates galaxies by switching optical and neutral hydrogen observations, reading motion from spectra, and following gas outside a galaxy. Scene: an inviting desk with a few paper astronomy folders, a warm desk lamp, and a window showing distant radio dish silhouettes beneath a quiet navy night sky. Composition: screen-dominant, nearly front-facing, comfortable to read as a future game scene. Keep a smaller observation-card area on the left, a larger clean data-display area on the right, and a broad uncluttered strip below for a future task bar. This layout is deliberate and will be shared by three art-direction alternatives. On the left, show one tasteful small spiral-galaxy illustration as a decorative archive thumbnail. The large data panel should be blank muted dark blue, with generous usable empty space; do not draw charts, scientific curves, axes, numeric readouts, or labels. Style: sophisticated handmade gouache and colored-pencil texture, gently rounded shapes, restrained charming detail, accessible to adults as well as students. Palette: midnight navy and warm cream with amber lamplight and a little muted teal. Constraints: no people, no aliens, no spacecraft, no visible text, no letters, no logos, no watermark, no invented scientific data. This is a non-interactive mood and composition concept, not a claim of a completed game. Background is opaque.
